summary: Iteration 56 — Infrastructure Phase A FRONTEND fully verified. /infrastructure loads without white-screen or JS errors. ForecastSection: 'Infrastructure Forecast' renders with forecast-target-input (default 1500000) and forecast-run-btn. Changing target to 500000 triggers GET /api/infrastructure/forecast?monthly_target=500000 (200), populates forecast-result with all required testids: forecast-active-domains (6/6), forecast-active-inboxes (19/19), forecast-daily-capacity (1,010), forecast-monthly-capacity (30,300), forecast-cap-30 (30,300), forecast-cap-60 (60,600), forecast-cap-90 (90,900), forecast-gap-card (Target 500,000 / Current 30,300), forecast-shortfall (-469,700 short), and recommendation block forecast-add-inboxes (+314) + forecast-add-domains (+105) since target > capacity. DomainTrackingSection: 'Domain Tracking & Expiry' renders with 6 bucket cards (dom-bucket-total/healthy/90/60/30/critical) and dom-add-btn. Clicking Track Domain opens dom-edit-dialog; filled domain=qa-test-domain.com, registrar=Cloudflare, expiry=+30 days; clicked dom-form-save → POST /api/infrastructure/domains 200; new row dom-row-qa-test-domain.com appeared with '30 days left' badge. dom-renewal-xlsx triggered a browser download (RouteMail_Domain_Renewal_Report_2026-06-12.xlsx) via GET /api/infrastructure/domains/renewal-report?format=xlsx → 200 with content-type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet. New header button infra-export-accounts-xlsx triggered download (RouteMail_Email_Accounts_2026-06-12.xlsx) via GET /api/infrastructure/accounts/export?format=xlsx → 200 with spreadsheetml content-type. Delete (dom-delete-qa-test-domain.com) triggered confirm dialog (auto-accepted), DELETE /api/infrastructure/domains/qa-test-domain.com → 200; row disappeared, list refreshed empty. Regression: infra-allocator-section AND infra-planner-section both still present and rendered. Login page (/login) still renders Cloudflare Turnstile 'Verify you are human' widget — no regression on captcha. Used Mongo session-token injection (TEST_iterPHA_*) to bypass Turnstile-gated /api/auth/login for the Infrastructure UI test (cleaned up post-run).

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning ('<tr> cannot be child of <span>' / '<span> cannot be child of <tbody>') from the emergent visual-editor <span data-ve-dynamic style=display:contents> wrapper between <tbody> and rows. Carried since iter-48 — NOT introduced by Phase A, NOT blocking. UI renders correctly.

action_items: No functional issues — Infrastructure Phase A frontend is shipping-ready. All requested testids render, all 4 backend API calls (forecast / domains CRUD / renewal-report xlsx / accounts/export xlsx) return 200 with correct content-types and binary blob downloads fire in the browser.
Main agent can self-test by re-loading /infrastructure after a fresh login — Phase A blocks should remain intact.
critical_code_review_comments: ForecastSection (Infrastructure.jsx ~1781-2000): clean useCallback-backed run() with loading/error states; defaults monthly_target=1500000 (sensible monthly cap); recommendation block conditional on shortfall>0 — correct gating.

DomainTrackingSection (~2080-2294): save() uses POST for new domains and PUT for edits keyed by domain_id; bucketStyle / bucketLabel pure helpers — clean. Delete uses window.confirm which auto-accepts in Playwright; fine for prod.

Email Accounts export button at line ~240-254 is inline-anonymous-async with try/catch swallowing errors as toast.error('Export failed') — acceptable but identical pattern to other export buttons; consider extracting to a single downloadAccounts helper to dedup the 5+ near-identical download blocks in this file (DRY).

Infrastructure.jsx is 2,315 lines — already flagged in iter-55 brief as exceeding 700-line guideline. Phase A added ~280 LOC for the two new sections inline at the bottom; refactor target: split ForecastSection + DomainTrackingSection + AllocatorSection + PlannerSection into /pages/infrastructure/*.jsx files. Not blocking.
Pre-existing set-state-in-effect warnings on lines 88/149 (carried since iter-51) — unchanged.

All Phase A testids use kebab-case as specified in brief; row testid template literal `dom-row-${d.domain}` includes the dot from 'qa-test-domain.com' — Playwright selector works fine but the dot in CSS-attribute-selector is safe inside quotes (verified).
